name: storage-sage-polish
title: Polish storage page with manager sage palette
description: Remove the remaining cream surfaces and align the complete storage management page with the manager dashboard sage-green visual system without changing inventory behavior.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Screenshot review found remaining cream in child selectors. The final theme now targets the actual il-card, il-stat-box, supply-card, sc-*, rc-card, toolbar, KPI, form and tab classes with higher page-scoped specificity. Inventory behavior is unchanged. Local component tests and build were not run in the connector-only environment.
